mentions.description: A personal cooking challenge series run by skyberrys during November (starting in October) consisting of weekly cooking challenges used to practice and refine a Thanksgiving day feast. The series is about three weeks out from the final meal; the current week is focused on brussels sprouts, with earlier weeks covering cauliflower and the classic seasoning blend of sage, rosemary, and thyme.
mentions.audience: Hobbyist home cooks practicing their Thanksgiving cooking
mentions.author: skyberrys
